item.title: When teens post selfies, how much filtering is too much?
item.description: The recent Meta settlement includes a clause banning cosmetic procedure filters for teens, but defining an extreme makeover is not easy.

item.title: More fathers take paid family leave for a new baby, sometimes matching mothers
item.description: The U.S. has no national paid parental leave law, but in states that do, more fathers are using the benefit, sometimes more than mothers.

item.title: Soldiers guard Milan center as thousands protest across European cities
item.description: Protests in France drew most international attention, but large demonstrations also took place Saturday in European cities from Milan to Rome.

item.title: Independent candidates see an opening in the West; Democrats hope they're right
item.description: Democrats are hoping independent candidates in Nebraska and Montana can help them defeat Republicans in a region as they seek Senate control.
